zh: 彻底移除所有后台自动全速 AOT 编译任务：杜绝后台多核 dex2oat 满载抢占 CPU 引起的系统卡顿与发热，AOT 极速编译仅在用户手动触发时执行
彻底消除按 Home 键偶发卡死 10 秒问题：全面移除锁死系统包管理服务的 dumpsys dexopt 调用，从播放器返回桌面秒开零卡顿
网络守护与红外遥控初始化去重优化：避免桌面重建时重复注册网络回调与重刷遥控驱动，操控更丝滑稳定
en: Removed all automatic background AOT compilation tasks: eliminates multi-core dex2oat CPU spikes and UI stutter; AOT compilation now runs strictly on manual user trigger
Fixed intermittent 10-second Home button freeze by removing system-locking dumpsys dexopt calls
Deduplicated network watchdog callbacks and Amlogic IR remote reloads across Activity recreations

zh: 彻底解决按 Home 键偶发卡死 10 秒问题：全面移除会锁死系统包管理服务的 dumpsys dexopt 调用，改用本地毫秒级 odex 校验，从播放器返回桌面秒开零卡顿
新增屏保空闲自动 AOT 巡检编译：进入屏保空闲后自动识别新装或刚升级的软件，带温控保护低优先级静默补齐极速机器码编译，退出屏保即时释放 CPU
网络守护与红外遥控初始化去重优化：杜绝桌面重建时重复注册网络回调与反复重刷遥控驱动，遥控器响应更稳更快
en: Fixed intermittent 10-second Home button freeze: eliminated system-locking dumpsys dexopt calls in favor of instant local odex checks for zero-lag Home return
Added Screensaver Idle AOT Patrol: automatically detects and low-priority compiles newly installed or updated apps during screensaver idle with thermal guard and instant wakeup abort
Startup optimizer deduplication: prevented duplicate network callbacks and redundant Amlogic IR remote reloads across Activity recreations

zh: 首次安装自动化一键优化：消除首次启动旧逻辑冲突，开机稳定后自动唤起「首次使用：一键全面优化」向导
核心应用补全升级（含抖音/爱壹帆/潘多拉等）：全面支持 HTTP 重定向自动跟随与直链下载，解决抖音等应用下载失败问题
Root 静默后台安装：具备 Root 权限时自动后台静默安装缺失官方应用，无需遥控器手动逐个确认安装
排版归位联动：一键优化或恢复默认排版后，新补全应用自动精准归位至预置官方位置，并联动执行 AOT 极速编译
SmartTube 双包名智能识别：兼容稳定版与经典版包名，避免已安装应用被误判缺失
屏保空闲自动 AOT 巡检编译：进入屏保待机后自动检测新装或刚升级的应用，带温控保护低优先级静默补齐极速机器码编译
en: First-Install Auto Optimization: Resolved first-launch prompt conflicts, cleanly showing 'First Use: Master Optimization' wizard
Core Apps Complement & Download Fix (TikTok/Pandora/etc.): Added HTTP redirect following and direct URL support, fixing TikTok download failures
Root Silent Background Install: Missing core apps install silently in the background when rooted, eliminating manual installer popups
Layout Auto-Arrangement: Newly installed core apps are automatically arranged to their official layout slots, followed by native AOT speed compilation
SmartTube Dual Package Recognition: Recognizes both stable and legacy package names seamlessly
Screensaver Idle AOT Patrol: Automatically detects and compiles newly installed or updated apps during screensaver idle with thermal protection

zh: 一键全面优化升级：新增「清理非官方应用」可选项（默认推荐勾选，取消勾选将保留所有现有第三方应用并归入未分类），并支持首次安装时智能引导全面初始化
使用教程开机启动项优化：教程最后一步「每次开机都显示此教程」默认保持未勾选，杜绝开机打扰，支持随时手动按需开启
移除常驻锁保障在线平滑升级：优化核心服务架构，彻底解决系统包管理器因常驻标记拦截在线更新与安装覆盖的问题，升级更顺畅
首帧瞬时快照秒开：基于本地闪存快照实现首帧磁贴毫秒级秒开，彻底消除冷启动与重新唤醒时的空白延迟
系统级核心常驻与防卸载保护：深度集成 Root 提权写入 /system/priv-app，享有系统特权与专属保活机制
应用名称自定义与遥控快捷键深度映射：长按菜单支持自定义重命名、专属遥控按键任意直达或彻底禁用
晶晨 Amlogic 芯片按键响应极速优化：智能消除遥控按键防抖延迟，遥控操作更灵敏顺滑
en: Master Optimization Enhancement: Added option to clean or keep non-official apps (uncheck to keep apps in Uncategorized folder), with smart first-install setup prompt
Tutorial Boot Option Refined: 'Show tutorial on boot' is now unchecked by default to prevent unwanted popups on startup
Seamless Package Updates: Removed restrictive persistent flag to allow smooth in-app OTA and manual apk updates without package installer lock
Instant First-Frame Cache: Loads leading home tiles from instant flash snapshot, eliminating blank dock delay on cold start
System Core App & Background Protection: Integrated root auto-promotion to /system/priv-app with system-level privileges
Custom App Renaming & Remote Key Mapping: Long-press menu supports custom renaming and dedicated remote shortcut binding
Amlogic Chip Remote Response Boost: Snappy remote keypress response with optimized debounce filters

zh: 使用教程引导优化：遥控器快捷指南与新手引导复选框视觉明确化（默认空心未勾选状态，不打扰开机）
首帧瞬时快照秒开：基于本地闪存快照实现首帧磁贴毫秒级秒开，彻底消除冷启动与重新唤醒时的空白延迟
系统级核心常驻与防杀保护：深度集成 Root 提权写入 /system/priv-app，激活原生 persistent 保活机制；一键全面优化自动检测并提升系统级
应用名称自定义与遥控快捷键深度映射：长按菜单支持自定义重命名、专属遥控按键任意直达或彻底禁用
晶晨 Amlogic 芯片按键响应极速优化：智能消除遥控按键防抖延迟，遥控操作更灵敏顺滑
壁纸缩略图动态内存池优化：基于 LruCache 智能管理画廊缓存，彻底杜绝老旧电视内存溢出风险
en: Onboarding Tutorial Polish: Refined remote shortcut guide with hollow unchecked toggle box by default to avoid intrusive popups
Instant First-Frame Cache: Loads leading home tiles from instant flash snapshot, eliminating blank dock delay on cold start
System Core App & Background Persistence: Integrated root auto-promotion to /system/priv-app with native persistent guard; Master Optimization auto-promotes to system app
Custom App Renaming & Remote Key Mapping: Long-press menu supports custom renaming and dedicated remote shortcut binding
Amlogic Chip Remote Response Boost: Snappy remote keypress response with optimized debounce filters
Wallpaper LruCache Memory Optimization: Dynamic thumbnail cache pool prevents OOM crashes on low-RAM TVs

zh: 首帧瞬时快照秒开：基于本地闪存快照实现首帧磁贴毫秒级秒开，彻底告别冷启动与重新唤醒时的空白延迟

遥控器快捷按键深度映射：支持直接拦截并录制遥控器专属按键（YouTube/Disney+/APPS等），绑定直达任意应用或彻底屏蔽禁用
晶晨 Amlogic 芯片按键响应极速优化：智能消除遥控按键防抖延迟，遥控操作更灵敏顺滑
新手导览教程全面升级：新增遥控器快捷键图文指引与技巧、支持上下步自由切换及开机启动自主选项
壁纸缩略图动态内存池优化：基于 LruCache 智能管理画廊缓存，彻底杜绝老旧电视内存溢出风险
en: Instant First-Frame Cache: Loads leading home tiles from instant flash snapshot, eliminating blank dock delay on cold start
System Core App & Background Persistence: Integrated root auto-promotion to /system/priv-app with native persistent guard; Master Optimization auto-promotes to system app
Custom App Renaming: Long press any app to edit its title (up to 24 chars) or reset back to default
Remote Shortcut Key Mapping: Intercept & map dedicated remote buttons (YouTube, APPS, etc.) to any app or block them
Amlogic Chip Remote Response Boost: Optimizes remote debounce delay & event queues for snappy navigation
Upgraded Onboarding Tour: Added visual remote shortcut guides, bidirectional navigation, and boot launch toggle
Wallpaper LruCache Memory Optimization: Dynamic thumbnail cache pool prevents OOM crashes on low-RAM TVs

zh: 全新新手交互导览教程：首次开机或随时从控制中心启动，智能高亮引导核心影视、直播、YouTube及系统设置
智能视口联动与高亮动画：导览时自动平滑滚动并高亮桌面目标应用，搭配极简毛玻璃卡片与遥控器指引
控制中心支持随时重温导览：控制中心快捷开启，可选择下次开机启动，指引完成后自动关闭不打扰
全语言本地化支持与性能细节体验优化
en: Interactive Onboarding Tour: Launch on first boot or from Control Center to guide through movies, IPTV, YouTube, and Settings
Smart Viewport & Tile Highlight: Automatically scrolls to and highlights target apps with frosted glass guide card
Control Center Quick Tour: Revisit the tour anytime, or schedule for next boot with auto-dismiss after completion
Full Multilingual Support: Updated localization across all supported languages with performance enhancements

zh: 控制中心新增 HDMI-CEC 设备联动一键控制：彻底解决由于系统 CEC 唤醒机制导致处于 HDMI 2 的盒子抢占正在观看其他 HDMI 信号源的严重问题
一键全面优化自动彻底关闭 HDMI-CEC：全流程第 3 步自动静默关闭并锁定 HDMI-CEC，彻底杜绝外接设备信号源抢占
一键全面优化自动锁定默认桌面：全流程第 4 步自动将 HMTV 设为系统默认桌面，开机与遥控器 Home 键稳定锁定
退回主页应用后台清理深度优化：全面重构为异步后台协程并发，移除破坏性页缓存冲刷，消除退回桌面时的瞬时卡顿与掉帧
en: Control Center HDMI-CEC Toggle: One-click disable to prevent the box from auto-waking and hijacking TV input signals on other HDMI ports
Master Boost Auto-Disables CEC: Step 3 of Master Optimization automatically turns off and locks HDMI-CEC to prevent input grabbing
Master Boost Auto-Locks Default Home: Step 4 automatically locks HMTV as the system default home activity via system package manager
Smooth Background App Auto-Close: Refactored to asynchronous coroutines and eliminated drop_caches to ensure 60fps smooth return to Home

zh: 新增一键全面优化：一键自动化完成系统深度瘦身、千兆网络加速、批量敏感授权、关闭谷歌保护、恢复默认排版与全速编译
流媒体与闪存内核深度调优：关闭空闲慢启动与闪存多余中断，开启 MTU 智能探测，彻底根治视频切片卡顿与丢包
退回主页智能自动关闭应用：支持立即、1分钟、3分钟自动清理，后台守护带三重安全校验，前台播放绝对豁免不杀
电源控制增强：控制中心新增关机、重启、恢复官方、重启至 Recovery 及电视原生设置入口，支持二次确认与倒计时
默认屏保更迭为照片模式：大幅降低芯片负载与解码器发热，待机运行更凉爽稳定
en: One-Click Master Optimization: Automatically runs deep cache cleaning, gigabit network boost, batch permissions, Google Protect disabling, default layout reset, and AOT speed compilation
Kernel & Streaming Deep Tuning: Disables TCP slow start after idle and disk stats overhead, enables MTU probing to eliminate video segment buffering
Smart Background App Auto-Close: Auto-terminates idle background apps (Immediately, 1m, 3m) with triple-layer foreground protection
Power Menu Enhancements: Direct access to Power Off, Reboot, Stock TV Launcher, Recovery Mode, and Native TV Settings with safe confirmation dialogs
Photo Screensaver by Default: Significantly reduces VPU hardware decoding strain and thermal dissipation during idle screensaver

zh: 新增网络极速优化与修复：一键扩增千兆 TCP 接收与发送缓冲、开启快速连接，跑满 4K 宽带
彻底解决 Wi-Fi 假死无网问题：自动禁用系统级 Captive Portal 与私密 DNS 阻断，锁定 Wi-Fi 绝不休眠
网卡收发队列与硬件复位：刷新 ARP 与路由死锁缓存，防网卡节电休眠挂死，断网自动静默自愈
控制中心与测速诊断双入口：随时一键提速，恢复默认排版时自动联动执行网络底层提速
后台轻量看门狗：5 分钟静默探针，遇到无网假死自动触发重连自愈，告别拔电源重启
en: Network Boost & Deep Repair: Enlarges TCP socket buffers for 4K streaming and high-speed gigabit throughput
Wi-Fi Zombie State Resolver: Disables blocking Captive Portal probes & Private DNS, prevents Wi-Fi sleep hanging
Hardware Transceiver Reset & ARP Flush: Refreshes stale ARP tables and route caches, disables 802.11 power save bugs
Integrated Control Center & Speed Test Access: One-click boost directly from Control Center or Speed Test page
Background Self-Healing Watchdog: 5-minute silent probe auto-revives stalled Wi-Fi chips without unplugging power

zh: 新增一键关闭谷歌保护：彻底关闭底层安装包验证与扫描阻止，消除“有害应用已阻止”弹窗，同时保留 Play 商店正常使用
恢复默认排版联动优化：点击恢复默认排版时，自动静默执行一键关闭谷歌保护与全套敏感权限授权
核心必备应用更新：当贝投屏与 ProtonVPN 设为出厂必备应用，保障投屏与网络连接体验
精准在线设备统计：适配 GA4 网页数据流 Measurement Protocol，毫秒级上报心跳与活跃会话，免去 GMS 依赖
IPTV 维护暗门防护：恢复功能转为安全暗门（连按 5 次版本号呼出），彻底杜绝其他电视盒误触覆盖数据与账号挤号风险
en: One-Click Disable Play Protect: Completely disables package verification & blocking popups while keeping Google Play Store fully functional
Auto-Optimization on Restore: Restoring default layout now automatically disables Play Protect and grants all permissions in one pass
Updated Essential Apps: Screencast and ProtonVPN are now standard apps to guarantee seamless casting and connectivity
Accurate Realtime Box Tracking: Optimized GA4 Web Measurement Protocol for accurate realtime device stats without GMS bloat
IPTV Maintenance Security Door: Protected IPTV restore behind a 5-click version trigger to prevent data overwrite and license conflicts on other devices

zh: 后台全自动温控防烧守护：开机即全自动开启巡检，每 5 分钟静默检测，过热自动触发降温与调频
前台播放绝对保护：用户正在全屏看电视时，严禁杀前台应用，CPU 采用 ondemand 动态按需调频，4K 60帧丝滑不卡顿
闲置挂机深度降温：桌面与屏保闲置时执行深度散热，彻底杜绝长时间开机烧毁板载 Wi-Fi 芯片
en: Automatic Thermal Guard: Enabled by default, silently polls temperature every 5 minutes and auto-cooldowns on overheating
Foreground Playback Protection: Never interrupts active video; uses dynamic ondemand scaling to guarantee smooth 4K 60fps
Idle Deep Cooldown: Actively cools down during launcher idle and screensaver to prevent board & Wi-Fi module burnout

zh: 新增温控降温与硬件防护：实时监测电视盒 SoC 温度，过热时一键降温，防止 Wi-Fi 芯片与主板元器件烧毁
Wi-Fi 射频功耗智能节流：降温时开启 Wi-Fi 扫描节流并切断后台流媒体与 PCDN 偷跑，大幅降低主板发热
动态温控调频：过热状态下自动调度 CPU 降温降频，保障外贸盒子长期稳定运行不烧机
en: Thermal Cooldown & Hardware Protection: Real-time SoC temperature monitoring with one-click cooldown to prevent Wi-Fi and hardware burnout
Wi-Fi RF & Stream Throttling: Throttles Wi-Fi scanning and cuts off leaking media/PCDN streams to reduce continuous heating
Dynamic CPU Governor Cooldown: Automatically relaxes CPU frequencies under high temperatures to ensure hardware longevity

zh: 默认语言设为简体中文：新机装机与未设置语言的设备直接默认简体中文显示，告别英文界面
新增一键恢复 IPTV：控制中心底部新增恢复功能，自动灌入黄金授权与频道库，秒级恢复
IPTV 自动下载安装闭环：电视若未安装 IPTV，自动静默下载官方安装包、静默安装并恢复授权
en: Default to Simplified Chinese: Fresh installs and unset devices default to Simplified Chinese
One-Click Restore IPTV: Restore golden account license and standard channel data from Control Center
Automated Download & Install: If IPTV is not installed, automatically downloads, installs, and activates it

zh: 新增一键垃圾清理：深度扫描清理第三方应用缓存、系统崩溃日志与残留安装包，释放存储空间
智能安全白名单：严格保护 IPTV 等关键电视软件与桌面核心排版，不清除账号与登录状态
极简清理确认与即时反馈：清理前优雅弹窗确认，清理后实时提示释放的存储空间大小
en: One-Click Junk Clean: Deep scan and clean third-party app caches, crash logs, and residual APK files to free up storage
Intelligent Safety Whitelist: Strictly protects IPTV and launcher settings to preserve logins and preferences
Clean Confirmation & Feedback: Minimalist glass confirmation dialog with instant feedback on freed storage space

zh: 控制中心纵向滚动支持：主面板开启平滑纵向滚动，适配各类电视屏幕，选项全部完整可见
恢复默认排版优化：位置上调至系统维护区域（一键授权下方），排版一目了然更易操作
全新 Wi-Fi 体验升级：支持纯英文键盘直接输入，自动聚焦输入框，连接更稳定便捷
首次使用向导：新机或恢复出厂后，智能检测并提示一键初始化官方排版与必备影视应用
Root 智能静默授权与 AOT Speed 机器码优化：全速编译优化大幅提升电视流畅度
en: Control Center Scrolling: Added smooth vertical scrolling to the main panel, ensuring all options are fully visible on any screen
Reset Layout Optimization: Moved 'Reset to Default Layout' to system maintenance section right under Permissions
Wi-Fi Connection Upgrades: Added pure English keyboard mode, auto-focus password input, and improved connection stability
First-Time Setup Guide: Automatically prompts to initialize standard official layout and essential media apps
Root Silent Permissions & AOT Speed Optimization: One-click optimization for lightning-fast TV performance

zh: 全新 Wi-Fi 体验升级：支持纯英文键盘直接输入，自动聚焦输入框，连接更稳定便捷
首次使用向导：新机或恢复出厂后，智能检测并提示一键初始化官方排版与必备影视应用
Root 智能静默授权：Root 设备自动开启无障碍极速安装助手，并支持一键静默授予全部应用权限
AOT Speed 极致优化：控制中心新增一键全速机器码编译优化，大幅提升电视流畅度与冷启动速度
en: Wi-Fi Connection Upgrades: Added pure English keyboard mode, auto-focus password input, and improved connection stability
First-Time Setup Guide: Automatically prompts to initialize standard official layout and essential media apps
Smart Root Permissions: Auto-enables Accessibility Assistant on rooted devices and grants all app permissions in one click
AOT Speed Machine Code Optimization: Added one-click AOT Speed optimization in Control Center for lightning-fast performance

zh: 云端标准排版还原：一键从云端拉取标准化排版（5大分类文件夹与第一排常用），自动还原
智能一键清理：恢复排版时自动安全清理非官方自装应用，严密保护系统组件与电视核心服务
必备应用按需补齐：支持可选（optional）与核心应用识别，缺失的核心影音自动下载安装
稳定性与无障碍极速安装助手优化
en: Cloud Master Layout Restore: One-click sync from cloud to restore standard 5 categorized folders and dock
Smart App Cleanup: Automatically and safely clean unauthorized third-party apps while strictly protecting system services
Essential App Rules: Flexible core vs optional app management with auto-download for missing core apps
Fast Install Assistant and system stability improvements

zh: 控制中心一键恢复默认排版：一键还原官方默认桌面排版，并自动检测补齐核心影音软件
新增极速安装助手：基于无障碍自动快速确认应用安装与权限，免反复按遥控器
个性化设置优化：新增极速安装助手开/关控制项
全量多语言更新与系统体验优化
en: One-click default layout restore: Reset home screen to official layout in Control Center with auto-install for missing core apps
Fast Install Assistant: Accessibility-based automatic confirmation of app installation and permissions
